_comment: Polished stainless steel: austenitic (304-type) stainless sheet polished to a bright, near-mirror finish, as on sink fronts, appliance trim, cutlery and fittings. Opaque, param-only: a solid metal with no texture of its own at this scale; the finish is the roughness. Base colour from Physically Based 'Stainless Steel'. APPROXIMATE: OpenPBR's metal edge tint (specular_color, the F82 tint) and the complex IOR are not carried by the library (F-LC-6), so the reflectance toward grazing angles is the base colour's Schlick fade, not steel's measured one. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): hairline scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, gated by the Edges mask (its B channel is the broad corner band meant for a deposit, its A the open faces meant for handling marks, so dust takes slot 2 and fingerprints slot 3). Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: StainlessSteel_Polished_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: roughness_const is not taken (the entry is an ideal mirror); the polish is the judgement below.

sources.why: roughness 0.1 for a bright polished (No. 8-like) sheet finish: a clear reflection with a faint micro-haze, a little softer than a buffed jewellery polish.
